Sends are sequential (awaited) rather than async-callback; event stream is deterministic, same IDs/acks.
No retries-count knob: attempts bounded by delivery.timeout.ms instead of Java retries=0.
--throughput 0 means unthrottled (adapter-defined; Java divides by zero); 0ms runs report avg_throughput 0.0 (Java prints non-standard Infinity).
Empty polls print nothing (Java blocks in poll, so unobservable there).
